subject: Object not found error when specifying observational covariate in formula in unmarked occu()

messages.author: 79b517e9298a19fe
messages.subject: Object not found error when specifying observational covariate in formula in unmarked occu()
parts:
Hello,

New user here so excuse my ignorance.

I have an R script here for learning occu() with some dummy/generated data:

https://framabin.org/?ddc6323e34b2e017#JvjEQTFzocdKNAq9VJH7+Y+9bnDQAKO2T6RVy4JrqHk=

As you can see part of it generates a list of observation-level covariates.

The script works up to `summary(dat)` which tells me:

> summary(dat)

 Mean   :-0.04899   Mean   : 0.2363  
 3rd Qu.: 0.56007   3rd Qu.: 0.7646  
 Max.   : 2.12478   Max.   : 2.3903  

When I try to run the `occu_model <- occu(~ 1 ~ obs_cov_1, dat)` function on this data, it gives me this error:

Error in eval(predvars, data, env) : object 'obs_cov_1' not found

As you can see in the code I was trying to specify `obs_cov_1` in the formula, but occu() didn't like it. What am I doing wrong when specifying covariates? Thank you!

P.S. Specifying site-level covariates produced NO errors....
